Keep the daily quote one tap away — add Daily Quotes to your home screen.

iPhone / iPad (Safari)

  1. Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up) at the bottom of Safari.
  2. Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
  3. Tap “Add” in the top-right corner.

The app will appear on your home screen just like any other app.

Android (Chrome)

  1. Tap the three-dot menu in the top-right corner of Chrome.
  2. Tap “Add to Home screen” (or “Install app”).
  3. Tap “Add” / “Install” to confirm.

You’re all set — Daily Quotes is already on your home screen.
